title: 第十五 章 初到夏家第 十六章 被看轻
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
陆行舟于流云仙城之中潜心修炼着，浑然不知在过去两年多的时光里，已然发生了诸多变故。
又历经一年的艰苦修行，陆行舟的修为成功攀升至炼气六层巅峰。
他尝试着突破当前境界，然而丹田内那澎湃的灵气，却仿佛遭遇了一层无形的壁垒，被死死挡住。
甚至在他尝试强行冲击时，还引发了灵力的反噬，致使经脉传来阵阵隐痛，吓得他立马停了下来。
陆行舟心中明白，这是自己此前过度依赖丹药修炼，致使经脉中悄然滋生了丹毒，且心境未能同步跟上所致。
“看来还是太过急功近利了。”
他嘴角泛起一丝自嘲的苦笑。
陆行舟缓缓站起身来，轻轻推开房门，走出客栈，沿着仙城的街道缓慢前行。
望着眼前人声鼎沸、热闹非凡的街道。
陆行舟的目光逐渐坚定，心中已然明晰自己接下来的方向。
近四年的修行时光，除去修炼所消耗的资源，他的储物袋中已积攒了近千块灵石。
然而，距离购买一颗筑基丹所需的巨额灵石，依旧相差甚远。
在仙城生活的这些年，他也了解到，筑基灵物唯有在大型拍卖会上才有可能现身。
而七年后，流云仙城将举办收徒大会，届时亦会同步举行大型拍卖会。
此举无疑能吸引众多修士纷至沓来，寻觅突破的机缘。
陆行舟思忖，既然当下无法突破修为。
倒不如趁着这段时间，多炼制一些丹药用以换取灵石，同时全力寻求炼丹术上的突破。
念及此，陆行舟不再迟疑，径直朝着摆摊区而去。
抵达摆摊区后，他将凝气丹的材料一扫而空，购置了近一百五十份之多。
而后，又挑选了三十多份聚气丹的材料。

聚气丹乃是炼气后期修士修炼不可或缺的灵丹，一颗聚气丹在市场上能轻松卖到四颗灵石，且供不应求。
陆行舟打算将它炼制出来，不但能让自己快速积累灵石，同时以后修炼他也需要。
购置完材料后，他未多做停留，径直返回客栈。
然而，刚至房门口，陆行舟便瞧见了一个令他倍感意外之人。
刹那间，他的脸上绽放出惊喜的笑容，赶忙热情地迎上前去。
“二叔！”
呼喊之余，陆行舟还下意识地左顾右盼。
陆引齐望向陆行舟，眼中闪过一丝惊讶，旋即微笑着点头赞许。
“不错，没想到短短几年未见，你的修为都赶超二叔我了。”
被陆引齐这般夸赞，陆行舟脸颊不禁有些微微泛红。
“二叔，就您一人前来吗？”
陆行舟一边说着，一边将陆引齐热情的迎进房间。
“怎么，难道二叔一个人还不够？”
陆引齐挑眉，笑容中带着几分调侃。
“我没这个意思，我只是想着您平日里不是要坐镇任务阁吗。”陆行舟赶忙解释道。
以往家族外出办事，大多是三叔承担，此次却是二叔前来，这让陆行舟心中满是疑惑。
陆引齐听闻此言，脸上瞬间浮现出一抹悲伤之色。
“你三叔，上次在返回坊市的途中，遭遇了一群黑衣人截杀……不幸罹难。”
“这也是家族这么久才来联系你的原因，实在是担心你因此暴露。”
陆引齐长叹一口气，语气中满是沉痛。

听闻此噩耗，陆行舟的脸上瞬间写满悲痛。
content_en:
Lu Xingzhou was practicing with great concentration in Liuyun Immortal City, unaware that many changes had occurred in the past two years or so.
After another year of hard training, Lu Xingzhou's cultivation level successfully climbed to the peak of the sixth level of Qi refining.
He tried to break through the current realm, but the surging spiritual energy in his dantian seemed to have encountered an invisible barrier and was blocked.
Even when he tried to force the impact, it triggered a backlash of spiritual power, causing bursts of dull pain in his meridians, which scared him to stop immediately.
Lu Xingzhou understood in his heart that this was due to his previous over-reliance on elixir cultivation, which caused erysipelas to quietly breed in his meridians, and his state of mind failed to keep up.
"It seems that we are still too eager for quick success."
A self-deprecating smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
Lu Xingzhou slowly stood up, gently opened the door, walked out of the inn, and walked slowly along the streets of Immortal City.
Looking at the bustling and bustling streets in front of me.
Lu Xingzhou's gaze gradually became firmer, and he already knew his next direction in his heart.
In the past four years of practice, excluding the resources consumed by practice, he has accumulated nearly a thousand spiritual stones in his storage bag.
However, it is still far from the huge amount of spiritual stones required to purchase a foundation-building pill.
During these years of living in Fairy City, he also learned that foundation-building spiritual objects could only appear at large-scale auctions.
Seven years later, Liuyunxian City will hold a disciple recruitment conference, and a large-scale auction will also be held simultaneously.
This move will undoubtedly attract many monks to come here in droves, looking for opportunities to break through.
Lu Xingzhou thought, since he couldn't break through his cultivation level at the moment.
It would be better to take advantage of this period of time to refine some more elixirs in exchange for spiritual stones, and at the same time, devote all efforts to seeking a breakthrough in alchemy.
Thinking of this, Lu Xingzhou no longer hesitated and headed straight towards the stall area.
After arriving at the stall area, he swept away the Qi Condensing Pill materials and purchased nearly 150 copies.
Then, more than 30 Qi Gathering Pill materials were selected.
The Qi Gathering Pill is an indispensable elixir for monks in the late stage of Qi refining. One Qi Gathering Pill can easily sell for four spirit stones in the market, and the supply exceeds demand.
Lu Xingzhou planned to refine it, which would not only allow him to quickly accumulate spiritual stones, but would also be needed for his future cultivation.
After purchasing the materials, he went straight back to the inn without making any further stops.
However, as soon as he arrived at the door of the room, Lu Xingzhou saw someone who surprised him.
In an instant, a smile of surprise broke out on his face, and he hurried forward to greet her enthusiastically.
"Second uncle!"
While shouting, Lu Xingzhou subconsciously looked around.
Lu Yinqi looked at Lu Xingzhou, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes, and then he smiled and nodded in approval.
"Yes, I didn't expect that in just a few years of seeing you, your cultivation level has surpassed that of my second uncle."
Being praised like this by Lu Yinqi, Lu Xingzhou's cheeks couldn't help but turn slightly red.
"Second uncle, are you the only one here?"
As Lu Xingzhou said this, he warmly welcomed Lu Yinqi into the room.
"Why, isn't it enough for the second uncle alone?"
Lu Yinqi raised his eyebrows, with a hint of teasing in his smile.
"I didn't mean that. I just thought that you would be in charge of the mission pavilion on weekdays." Lu Xingzhou explained quickly.
In the past, when the family went out to do business, most of the third uncle was responsible for it, but this time it was the second uncle who came, which made Lu Xingzhou full of doubts.
When Lu Yinqi heard this, a look of sadness instantly appeared on his face.
"Your third uncle, on his way back to Fang City last time, he was intercepted and killed by a group of men in black... and unfortunately died."
"This is why the family took so long to contact you. They were really worried that you would be exposed."
Lu Yinqi let out a long sigh, his tone full of sorrow.
Upon hearing the bad news, Lu Xingzhou's face was filled with grief.
